entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph system that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It integrates automated fact extraction and byte-level deduplication with connectors for platforms including Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An AGPL-3.0 context database that utilizes a virtual filesystem structure with viking:// URIs and tiered hierarchical loading. It provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and has demonstrated a 91% token reduction on LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain extracts entity relationships without LLM calls and provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis. It is designed for institutional memory, supporting multi-user environments with scoped data access.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents through a FastAPI server that supports hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes memory implementations and offers both Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider manages context as a git-like repository with versioning features such as commit, branch, and merge. It achieves sub-100ms performance using a 5-tier retrieval system and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system manages persistent memory via Qdrant and structured facts to create an auto-curated wiki for the agent. It relies on local infrastructure including Docker, Redis, and SQLite to maintain a Ground Truth hierarchy for context prioritization.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness helps agents complete complex tasks by generating filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks. It supports multiple providers, including local models and OpenAI-compatible APIs, via Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It features a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata and builds depth-aware summary nodes for hierarchical searching.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library to enable private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It imports data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable memory on local disks. It supports MCP tools including Claude Code and Cursor through a local-first retrieval stack using BM25 and hybrid search.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, Claude Code hooks, and plugins using a hybrid retrieval method involving BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to reduce prefill latency and token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching why_retrieved tags to every recall. It supports in-process embedded mode by default and includes features for contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens before the context window opens. It supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE and pairs with Perseus Vault for encrypted, persistent memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features BM25-first retrieval and an importance ranking system from 1-10 to prioritize high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates payments for APIs and AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to enable self-charging capabilities.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local capabilities such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It provides tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal, with an optional feature for automatic tool-routing note generation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, alongside configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports multiple execution modes via Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall alongside MinHash dedup.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin provides private code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods with automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework utilizes subagent-driven development to enable autonomous task execution. It integrates with coding harnesses like Claude, Codex, and Cursor while enforcing TDD and YAGNI principles.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first prototyping system that supports various local CLI executables and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It includes a design system and can generate HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory via a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It can build these graphs from any data format and offers Rust and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts Mermaid text into editable .drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for generating diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides adjudication for deals and includes official protocol skills. It manages natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, x402 payments, and escrow.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill deduplication and quality improvement to allow skills to evolve collectively. It synchronizes skill libraries across team environments and multiple devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This library provides spec-conformant Agent Plugins that are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state in a docs/ folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1099 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for use with other assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation to manage detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, these skills provide access to YouTube transcripts, searches, channels, and playlists. They are compatible with the Agent Skills format and work with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances reporting by providing findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots identified during the process.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough ideas to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for varying complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness provides structured memory through file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It utilizes a three-level work model and a CLI for managing tasks and card-based memory.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin implements cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides interoperable skills for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized support for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers installation guides and skills formatted in SKILL.md specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This repository provides official integration for FLUX image and video generation, including prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 models. It contains API documentation, code examples, and six specialized skills for video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts existing code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures transparency by providing provenance through file and line number citations for both Node.js and Python environments.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with support for recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client, a CLI, and commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks through autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability for long-running processes by incorporating built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language for AI that uses a single file and four verbs to define 'Intent as Code.' It supports local-first execution with any model and provides static auditing alongside tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for credential validation and ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and FTS5 to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed to reduce token consumption and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and exploits. The tool verifies findings through sandbox execution and incorporates a deterministic pre-scan using utilities like Semgrep, Bandit, and ESLint.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This community hub facilitates the browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills following the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and CLI by tailoring rewrites to specific model families and reasoning capabilities. It tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database while preserving non-English prompts through specialized heuristics.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system where an agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores data locally in SQLite and connects to AI agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This adaptation implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates to ground agent actions. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python-based goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses three parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal or AI agent access to a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates the discovery and direct installation of plugins for MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a quality seal by testing the structure, functionality, and security of agent skills within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and offers a public API for skill submission and verification.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This multi-scale news generator for Hermes Agent produces structured reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and includes AI analysis for action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local OCR for PDFs and video-to-text transcription via links or local files to maintain data privacy. It also features an e-commerce studio for batch material generation with brand overlays and tools for AI text refinement.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This utility manages deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It functions without network requests or package installations, using a PowerShell resolver to verify project-compatible interpreters.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, and their associated development tools. It supports a variety of licensing models, including MIT, Apache-2.0, and unfree licenses, for integration into Nix-based environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It includes a gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and enables users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative configuration of Hermes Agent settings and workspace documents. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates secure secrets handling via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides monitoring tools for per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with distinct identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable production package that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, offering Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments for offline use.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and employs a researcher team to assess insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It supports frameworks such as CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for registry management, security auditing, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale agents into automated teams. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers and MCP tool integration. It features durable agent memory and visual org charts for delegating agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system provides a Kanban board and review queues to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work. It features live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage automated task lifecycles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TerminalBench-2 and TBLite while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for tool-calling and task routing without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a CLI interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, with support for data submission to public profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other tools. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends across 30+ AI coding tools.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without requiring OAuth or separate processes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports various AI providers and includes a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and undo functionality for agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including memory tools for Slack, Telegram, and VS Code. It also offers a plugin for Claude Code featuring automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through specialized CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies inconsistent schemas, overlapping tool descriptions, and missing stop conditions via local execution, GitHub Actions, or pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides offline, local interaction with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users to handle multiple agentic tools. It serves as an all-in-one hub for managing Hermes Agent alongside other command-line tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local coworking application that enables 24/7 scheduled automation for Hermes Agent via Cron. It supports remote access through WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, featuring 21 built-in assistants for generating office documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent through a web browser or SSH tunnel. It includes a workspace file browser with inline previews, optimized for both desktop and mobile use.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience by providing guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. The application includes a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers comprehensive management of Hermes Agent through visual workflow builders, Kanban boards, and usage analytics. It supports streaming responses and tool traces while facilitating communication across ten platform channels including Discord and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated catalog for managing skills and MCP tools.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a single desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports thirteen built-in agents and offers native mobile clients for both iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with a real terminal for system repair. It features native views for managing sessions, skills, and cron jobs directly from macOS.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application, built with Tauri and Rust, includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing native dialogs for memory and MCP tool management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features 'Hermes Assist' for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments and a dedicated web interface for full-page session management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a web server to provide mobile management of agent tasks, skills, and read-only access to memory analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and features a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency. It provides a live monitoring environment for observing code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal, real-time chat with tool call visualization, and a dedicated status panel for monitoring agent health and system metrics.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit designed to track analytics and limits for Hermes alongside various other coding-agent CLIs. It offers searchable transcript history, image browsing, and live per-session quota burn-rates for specific models like Codex and Claude.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It distinguishes itself by integrating a WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for audio-based interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox designed to manage agent requests that result in side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative interface uses OpenTUI to provide a terminal-based dashboard for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and allows users to configure profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets within the TUI.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and secures sessions using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights, offering a portable solution for running Hermes with local models via LM Studio. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers and supports integrated workflows for TTS and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for the self-hosted AI assistant. It includes dedicated management tools for organizing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through a browser-based file explorer.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process oversight by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first design with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and supports isolated profile management for maintaining separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with on-the-fly model switching.
